summary.text: Mike Robinson is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 95 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired business leader who has lived in central North Carolina for 40 years.

paragraphs.text: Mike Robinson was born in Wilmington, Delaware, and earned a bachelor's degree from Elon University in 1980 and a graduate degree from Charter Oak State College.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes work as a business consultant.
In the survey, he said he has been a community volunteer with schools, scouts and state government and is a recipient of the Order of the Long Leaf Pine.
Robinson was the Democratic nominee for District 95 in 2024, when Todd Carver (R) defeated him in the general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he named honesty, integrity and transparency in state government as his policy focus and said he supports public education.
He listed the Metrolina Labor Council and Planned Parenthood as endorsers.
